requirements.section: Product Vision, Scope and Quality Baseline
requirements.short_requirement: The delivered product MUST be a functioning multi-tenant SaaS, not a static prototype; primary screens must read and write real persisted data through authorized APIs.

requirements.section: Product Vision, Scope and Quality Baseline
requirements.short_requirement: The product MUST provide the three solution layers: public website, tenant application and platform operator console.

requirements.section: Product Vision, Scope and Quality Baseline
requirements.short_requirement: All tenant-owned data MUST be isolated server-side; frontend filtering alone is never sufficient tenant isolation.

requirements.section: Product Vision, Scope and Quality Baseline
requirements.short_requirement: Critical mutations, exports, impersonation and configuration changes MUST be auditable.

requirements.section: Product Vision, Scope and Quality Baseline
requirements.short_requirement: All MUST requirements in this specification MUST have test evidence before production sign-off.

requirements.section: Product Vision, Scope and Quality Baseline
requirements.short_requirement: The UI SHOULD present a coherent premium product experience across desktop, tablet and mobile.

requirements.section: Product Vision, Scope and Quality Baseline
requirements.short_requirement: Optional extensions MUST be isolated behind configuration or feature flags where their availability varies by plan, provider or contract.

requirements.section: Product Vision, Scope and Quality Baseline
requirements.short_requirement: The system MUST fail safely when mandatory production configuration or secrets are missing.

requirements.section: Product Vision, Scope and Quality Baseline
requirements.short_requirement: User-visible operations MUST have clear loading, success, empty and error states; silent failure is not acceptable.

requirements.section: Product Vision, Scope and Quality Baseline
requirements.short_requirement: The software MUST use original implementation and legally usable dependencies; dependency licences must be documented in the delivery package.

requirements.section: Solution Architecture and Environment Model
requirements.short_requirement: The backend MUST use Django 5+ and Django REST Framework or an equivalent maintained Django API layer, with Python 3.12+ for the production baseline unless the approved runtime matrix states otherwise.

requirements.section: Solution Architecture and Environment Model
requirements.short_requirement: The frontend MUST use Next.js App Router with TypeScript and a production build pipeline.

requirements.section: Solution Architecture and Environment Model
requirements.short_requirement: PostgreSQL MUST be the production system of record and MUST not be exposed directly to the public Internet.

requirements.section: Solution Architecture and Environment Model
requirements.short_requirement: Redis MUST provide cache/queue support and MUST not be publicly exposed.

requirements.section: Solution Architecture and Environment Model
requirements.short_requirement: Celery worker and Celery Beat (or equivalent) MUST run background and scheduled workloads outside web request threads.

requirements.section: Solution Architecture and Environment Model
requirements.short_requirement: Private/generated files MUST support S3- compatible object storage; local volume storage MAY be used for development.

requirements.section: Solution Architecture and Environment Model
requirements.short_requirement: Production containers MUST run as non- root users wherever technically practical.

requirements.section: Solution Architecture and Environment Model
requirements.short_requirement: A reverse proxy/TLS termination layer MUST expose only intended web ports; database/cache ports remain private.

requirements.section: Solution Architecture and Environment Model
requirements.short_requirement: The application MUST support separate local, staging and production configuration without committing secrets.

requirements.section: Solution Architecture and Environment Model
requirements.short_requirement: Database migrations MUST run as a controlled one-shot release step before dependent web/worker processes are considered healthy.

requirements.section: Multi-Tenancy, Identity, MFA and Session Security
requirements.short_requirement: Every tenant-owned API query and mutation MUST resolve an authorized tenant context from the authenticated user and server-side membership.

requirements.section: Multi-Tenancy, Identity, MFA and Session Security
requirements.short_requirement: Users with access to multiple lodges MUST be able to switch active lodge without gaining access to lodges for which membership is absent.

requirements.section: Multi-Tenancy, Identity, MFA and Session Security
requirements.short_requirement: Login MUST support configured username/email credentials and MUST not reveal whether a username or email exists through unsafe error differences.

requirements.section: Multi-Tenancy, Identity, MFA and Session Security
requirements.short_requirement: TOTP MFA enrollment, verification and enforcement MUST be supported, with server-side replay resistance and a secure recovery/reset process.

requirements.section: Multi-Tenancy, Identity, MFA and Session Security
requirements.short_requirement: MFA enrollment or reset MUST require recent password verification or equivalent strong re-authentication.

requirements.section: Multi-Tenancy, Identity, MFA and Session Security
requirements.short_requirement: Invitations and password-setup/reset tokens MUST expire and be single-use.

requirements.section: Multi-Tenancy, Identity, MFA and Session Security
requirements.short_requirement: Session timeout and optional tenant IP allowlist policies MUST be configurable and enforced server-side.

requirements.section: Multi-Tenancy, Identity, MFA and Session Security
requirements.short_requirement: Sensitive actions such as credential changes, impersonation and MFA reset SHOULD require step-up authentication.

requirements.section: Multi-Tenancy, Identity, MFA and Session Security
requirements.short_requirement: Logout MUST terminate server/browser session state and handle unsynchronised offline work safely.

requirements.section: Multi-Tenancy, Identity, MFA and Session Security
requirements.short_requirement: Authentication cookies MUST be Secure in production, HttpOnly where applicable, and configured with an appropriate SameSite policy.

requirements.section: Roles, Permissions and Approval Model
requirements.short_requirement: Permissions MUST be enforced server-side for view/create/edit/delete/export/approve/admi n actions, not only by hiding UI controls.

requirements.section: Roles, Permissions and Approval Model
requirements.short_requirement: Tenant administrators MUST be able to create custom tenant roles from allowed permission primitives.

requirements.section: Roles, Permissions and Approval Model
requirements.short_requirement: Platform roles MUST separate support, billing, compliance and operations responsibilities to reduce unnecessary access to member PII and credentials.

requirements.section: Roles, Permissions and Approval Model
requirements.short_requirement: A user MUST never assign a role or permission higher than the assigning user is authorized to grant.

requirements.section: Roles, Permissions and Approval Model
requirements.short_requirement: Sensitive exports MAY require approval based on tenant policy, data type, record count or role.

requirements.section: Roles, Permissions and Approval Model
requirements.short_requirement: Permission changes MUST invalidate or refresh authorization caches promptly.

requirements.section: Roles, Permissions and Approval Model
requirements.short_requirement: Custom roles MUST remain scoped to the owning tenant.

requirements.section: Roles, Permissions and Approval Model
requirements.short_requirement: Denied actions MUST return an appropriate 401/403/404 response without leaking cross-tenant object existence.

requirements.section: Public Website, Visual CMS, SEO and Lead Capture
requirements.short_requirement: The public marketing site MUST be CMS- driven; core content must not require code changes to edit.

requirements.section: Public Website, Visual CMS, SEO and Lead Capture
requirements.short_requirement: Page Studio MUST provide visual block- based editing with add/edit/duplicate/move/hide/delete operations and drag/drop reordering; administrators MUST NOT be required to edit raw JSON for ordinary use.

requirements.section: Public Website, Visual CMS, SEO and Lead Capture
requirements.short_requirement: Page Studio MUST support at least hero, rich text, feature grid, statistics, image/text split, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, lead form and CTA blocks.

requirements.section: Public Website, Visual CMS, SEO and Lead Capture
requirements.short_requirement: Editors MUST have desktop/tablet/mobile preview and draft/published state controls.

requirements.section: Public Website, Visual CMS, SEO and Lead Capture
requirements.short_requirement: CMS changes SHOULD support version history or recoverable revisions for published pages.

requirements.section: Public Website, Visual CMS, SEO and Lead Capture
requirements.short_requirement: The media library MUST support validated upload, search/filter, preview, metadata editing, alt text/accessibility description, public/private designation and deletion.

requirements.section: Public Website, Visual CMS, SEO and Lead Capture
requirements.short_requirement: Navigation management MUST provide visual ordering, nested/dropdown items, footer/legal/social groups and visibility controls.

requirements.section: Public Website, Visual CMS, SEO and Lead Capture
requirements.short_requirement: Branding MUST include logo, favicon, theme colors and typography presets with accessible defaults.

requirements.section: Public Website, Visual CMS, SEO and Lead Capture
requirements.short_requirement: Per-page SEO MUST include title, description, canonical URL, index/no-index, OpenGraph/Twitter metadata, social image and schema/structured-data settings where applicable.

requirements.section: Public Website, Visual CMS, SEO and Lead Capture
requirements.short_requirement: The platform MUST generate robots.txt and sitemap content and support 301/302 redirects, custom slugs and custom 404 content.

requirements.section: Public Website, Visual CMS, SEO and Lead Capture
requirements.short_requirement: Lead forms MUST support configurable fields/validation, anti-abuse rate limiting, destination/routing and an operator lead inbox with status workflow.

requirements.section: Public Website, Visual CMS, SEO and Lead Capture
requirements.short_requirement: Global announcements MUST support active windows, audience/placement configuration and safe enable/disable controls.

requirements.section: Public Website, Visual CMS, SEO and Lead Capture
requirements.short_requirement: Analytics/marketing pixels MUST be configurable and MUST respect consent settings where consent is required.

requirements.section: Public Website, Visual CMS, SEO and Lead Capture
requirements.short_requirement: Localization MAY provide translated page variants, locale switching and per-tenant defaults without duplicating site code.

requirements.section: Platform Administration and Operator Console
requirements.short_requirement: Authorized platform admins MUST be able to create, activate, suspend and disable tenants and assign plans/feature entitlements.

requirements.section: Platform Administration and Operator Console
requirements.short_requirement: Tenant suspension MUST prevent normal enant use without deleting tenant data.

requirements.section: Platform Administration and Operator Console
requirements.short_requirement: Platform user administration MUST support lock/unlock, role assignment and MFA policy enforcement.

requirements.section: Platform Administration and Operator Console
requirements.short_requirement: Support impersonation MUST require a reason, show a persistent impersonation banner, be time-bounded and be fully audited.

requirements.section: Platform Administration and Operator Console
requirements.short_requirement: Billing administration MUST show subscription state, plan, customer/provider references and relevant billing events without exposing raw secrets.

requirements.section: Platform Administration and Operator Console
requirements.short_requirement: Feature flags MUST be configurable globally and per tenant with safe default behaviour.

requirements.section: Platform Administration and Operator Console
requirements.short_requirement: Encrypted provider credentials MUST support test/live separation, enable/disable, rotation and health status.

requirements.section: Platform Administration and Operator Console
requirements.short_requirement: Operations views MUST expose audit, export, webhook, background-job and email-delivery logs appropriate to the operator role.

requirements.section: Platform Administration and Operator Console
requirements.short_requirement: Platform administrative destructive actions MUST use application-controlled confirmation dialogs with loading and error states rather than native browser prompts.

requirements.section: Platform Administration and Operator Console
requirements.short_requirement: Billing-only roles MUST not receive member PII unless explicitly granted by a separate approved permission.

requirements.section: Tenant Administration, Branding and Configuration
requirements.short_requirement: Tenant settings MUST include lodge name/number, address, jurisdiction and meeting defaults.

requirements.section: Tenant Administration, Branding and Configuration
requirements.short_requirement: Each tenant MUST support logo/branding and an accessible theme preset or controlled theme customization.

requirements.section: Tenant Administration, Branding and Configuration
requirements.short_requirement: Tenant admins MUST be able to define custom member fields with type, label, required/optional rule and display order where permitted.

requirements.section: Tenant Administration, Branding and Configuration
requirements.short_requirement: Candidate stage definitions MUST be tenant-configurable while preserving referential history for existing candidates.

requirements.section: Tenant Administration, Branding and Configuration
requirements.short_requirement: Dues settings MUST include currency, receipt prefix/sequence policy, proration/late-fee options and payment- method availability.

requirements.section: Tenant Administration, Branding and Configuration
requirements.short_requirement: Tenant templates MUST support letterhead, minutes/summons, receipts and signature blocks using validated merge fields.

requirements.section: Tenant Administration, Branding and Configuration
requirements.short_requirement: Security settings MUST include MFA policy, session timeout and optional IP allowlist.

requirements.section: Tenant Administration, Branding and Configuration
requirements.short_requirement: Retention and anonymization controls MUST be configurable subject to operator/legal policy constraints.

requirements.section: Tenant Administration, Branding and Configuration
requirements.short_requirement: Tenant settings changes MUST be audited with before/after values for non-secret fields and secret-safe metadata for credentials.

requirements.section: Dashboard, Workspace Navigation and Global Search
requirements.short_requirement: Dashboard KPIs MUST derive from tenant data and respect user permissions.

requirements.section: Dashboard, Workspace Navigation and Global Search
requirements.short_requirement: Baseline KPIs MUST include members, dues/arrears, attendance and candidates, plus actionable overdue alerts where data is available.

requirements.section: Dashboard, Workspace Navigation and Global Search
requirements.short_requirement: Recent activity MUST be sourced from auditable events and filtered to the active tenant.

requirements.section: Dashboard, Workspace Navigation and Global Search
requirements.short_requirement: Quick actions MUST only be shown/enabled when the user can complete the underlying action.

requirements.section: Dashboard, Workspace Navigation and Global Search
requirements.short_requirement: Primary modules MUST remain reachable within a consistent workspace navigation model on desktop and mobile.

requirements.section: Dashboard, Workspace Navigation and Global Search
requirements.short_requirement: Global search SHOULD return authorized members, candidates, meetings, documents and other configured entities without cross- tenant leakage.

requirements.section: Dashboard, Workspace Navigation and Global Search
requirements.short_requirement: Dashboard queries SHOULD use bounded pagination/caching and must not load unbounded tenant datasets into the browser.

requirements.section: Members CRM and Lifecycle Management
requirements.short_requirement: Member records MUST support status lifecycle, contact information, key dates, tags/groups, notes and tenant-defined custom fields.

requirements.section: Members CRM and Lifecycle Management
requirements.short_requirement: Member create/update MUST validate required fields, field formats and tenant ownership of related objects.

requirements.section: Members CRM and Lifecycle Management
requirements.short_requirement: The system MUST perform duplicate detection on configured identity/contact fields and warn before creating likely duplicates.

requirements.section: Members CRM and Lifecycle Management
requirements.short_requirement: Authorized users MUST be able to merge duplicates using a controlled merge workflow that preserves required history and audit evidence.

requirements.section: Members CRM and Lifecycle Management
requirements.short_requirement: Bulk actions MUST be bounded, permission-checked and auditable; large or sensitive exports MAY require approval.

requirements.section: Members CRM and Lifecycle Management
requirements.short_requirement: CSV/XLSX import MUST provide mapping, validation, preview, per-row errors and duplicate handling before commit.

requirements.section: Members CRM and Lifecycle Management
requirements.short_requirement: Member export MUST support configured CSV/Excel/PDF views and record the exporter, filters, record count and timestamp.

requirements.section: Members CRM and Lifecycle Management
requirements.short_requirement: Member attachments MUST be linked through the secure document system with ACL enforcement.

requirements.section: Members CRM and Lifecycle Management
requirements.short_requirement: Anonymization/deletion operations MUST protect financial, audit and governance integrity according to retention policy.

requirements.section: Members CRM and Lifecycle Management
requirements.short_requirement: Member activity/history SHOULD show relevant changes, meeting participation, dues and communications subject to permission.

requirements.section: Officers, Terms and Governance Records
requirements.short_requirement: Officer assignments MUST reference valid tenant members and tenant-scoped officer- role definitions.

requirements.section: Officers, Terms and Governance Records
requirements.short_requirement: Officer terms MUST record role, holder, start/end dates and status/history without overwriting prior terms.

requirements.section: Officers, Terms and Governance Records
requirements.short_requirement: The system MUST provide a current officer roster and historical archive.

requirements.section: Officers, Terms and Governance Records
requirements.short_requirement: Printable officer roster MUST use the tenant report/document branding standard.

requirements.section: Officers, Terms and Governance Records
requirements.short_requirement: Overlapping officer terms SHOULD be validated or explicitly confirmed where multiple holders are allowed by configuration.

requirements.section: Officers, Terms and Governance Records
requirements.short_requirement: Succession planning and nominations MAY be enabled as an extension without changing the core officer history model.

requirements.section: Candidates, Degree Pipeline, Mentors and Milestones
requirements.short_requirement: Candidate stages MUST be configurable per tenant and ordered.

requirements.section: Candidates, Degree Pipeline, Mentors and Milestones
requirements.short_requirement: Candidate transition MUST be performed through a controlled server-side transition action, not by directly editing the stage field.

requirements.section: Candidates, Degree Pipeline, Mentors and Milestones
requirements.short_requirement: Required tasks/milestones MUST be enforceable before a normal stage transition; privileged override MUST require permission and reason.

requirements.section: Candidates, Degree Pipeline, Mentors and Milestones
requirements.short_requirement: Every stage transition MUST record previous stage, new stage, date/time and actor.

requirements.section: Candidates, Degree Pipeline, Mentors and Milestones
requirements.short_requirement: Candidates MUST support one or more mentor assignments according to tenant policy.

requirements.section: Candidates, Degree Pipeline, Mentors and Milestones
requirements.short_requirement: Tasks/checklists MUST support assignee, due date, status, notes and overdue detection.

requirements.section: Candidates, Degree Pipeline, Mentors and Milestones
requirements.short_requirement: Pipeline analytics MUST include stage counts and SHOULD include conversion, time-in-stage and mentor workload.

requirements.section: Candidates, Degree Pipeline, Mentors and Milestones
requirements.short_requirement: Candidate records and analytics MUST remain tenant-scoped and permission- scoped.

requirements.section: Meetings, Agenda, Attendance, Visitors and Minutes
requirements.short_requirement: Meetings MUST support date/time, location, type/status and tenant-configured defaults.

requirements.section: Meetings, Agenda, Attendance, Visitors and Minutes
requirements.short_requirement: Agenda builder MUST support standard and custom ordered agenda items.

requirements.section: Meetings, Agenda, Attendance, Visitors and Minutes
requirements.short_requirement: Recurring meeting rules MUST be storable and, when enabled, future meetings MUST be generated idempotently without duplicates.

requirements.section: Meetings, Agenda, Attendance, Visitors and Minutes
requirements.short_requirement: Attendance MUST support at least present/absent/excused states and MUST prevent duplicate member attendance rows for the same meeting.

requirements.section: Meetings, Agenda, Attendance, Visitors and Minutes
requirements.short_requirement: Visitors MUST be recorded separately from members and linked to the meeting with relevant lodge/contact/notes fields as configured.

requirements.section: Meetings, Agenda, Attendance, Visitors and Minutes
requirements.short_requirement: Minutes MUST follow Draft -> Review -> Approved -> Locked states with version history.

requirements.section: Meetings, Agenda, Attendance, Visitors and Minutes
requirements.short_requirement: Approved/locked minutes MUST not be silently edited; changes require a controlled reopen/new-version process with permission and audit reason.

requirements.section: Meetings, Agenda, Attendance, Visitors and Minutes
requirements.short_requirement: The system MUST generate branded minutes, summons/notice, attendance sheet and meeting pack PDFs.

requirements.section: Meetings, Agenda, Attendance, Visitors and Minutes
requirements.short_requirement: Meeting pack generation SHOULD combine agenda, notices, attendance template, approved prior minutes and configured attachments where applicable.

requirements.section: Meetings, Agenda, Attendance, Visitors and Minutes
requirements.short_requirement: QR check-in MAY be enabled as an extension while preserving manual attendance controls.

requirements.section: Dues, Assessments, Payments, Receipts and Finance
requirements.short_requirement: Dues cycles MUST have explicit period/status and generate tenant-scoped member assessments according to configured rules.

requirements.section: Dues, Assessments, Payments, Receipts and Finance
requirements.short_requirement: Assessment generation MUST be idempotent so retrying a cycle generation does not create duplicate assessments.

requirements.section: Dues, Assessments, Payments, Receipts and Finance
requirements.short_requirement: Proration and late-fee calculations MUST be deterministic, documented and testable against fixtures.

requirements.section: Dues, Assessments, Payments, Receipts and Finance
requirements.short_requirement: Paid assessments MUST not allow destructive edits to amount/terms; corrections require adjustment/reversal/waiver workflows.

requirements.section: Dues, Assessments, Payments, Receipts and Finance
requirements.short_requirement: Waivers MUST require appropriate permission and record reason/actor/date.

requirements.section: Dues, Assessments, Payments, Receipts and Finance
requirements.short_requirement: Manual payments MUST support configured methods such as cash, bank transfer and cheque and MUST create a single payment record and receipt.

requirements.section: Dues, Assessments, Payments, Receipts and Finance
requirements.short_requirement: Receipt numbers MUST be server- generated, unique within tenant policy and race-safe under concurrent payment creation.

requirements.section: Dues, Assessments, Payments, Receipts and Finance
requirements.short_requirement: Member statements MUST reconcile assessments, payments, waivers/adjustments and outstanding balance.

requirements.section: Dues, Assessments, Payments, Receipts and Finance
requirements.short_requirement: Arrears reporting MUST support aging/status and member drill-down.

requirements.section: Dues, Assessments, Payments, Receipts and Finance
requirements.short_requirement: Expenses and categories SHOULD support date, category, amount, payee, description, attachment and approval fields as configured.

requirements.section: Dues, Assessments, Payments, Receipts and Finance
requirements.short_requirement: Finance exports MUST preserve decimal/currency precision and use tenant locale/date/currency configuration.

requirements.section: Dues, Assessments, Payments, Receipts and Finance
requirements.short_requirement: Financial actions MUST be audited and high-risk finance functions MUST remain online-only when offline/PWA mode is available.

requirements.section: Documents, Templates, Media and Secure File Handling
requirements.short_requirement: Private documents MUST be tenant-scoped and protected by folder/document ACLs and server-authorized download.

requirements.section: Documents, Templates, Media and Secure File Handling
requirements.short_requirement: Uploads MUST validate filename, extension/MIME agreement, magic signature for supported types, size and archive-expansion limits before acceptance.

requirements.section: Documents, Templates, Media and Secure File Handling
requirements.short_requirement: Production uploads MUST support ClamAV or equivalent malware scanning; when fail- closed mode is configured, unavailable scanning MUST reject/quarantine uploads.

requirements.section: Documents, Templates, Media and Secure File Handling
requirements.short_requirement: Private storage objects MUST not be made public merely to enable browser download.

requirements.section: Documents, Templates, Media and Secure File Handling
requirements.short_requirement: Deleting an application document MUST delete or lifecycle the corresponding storage object according to retention policy.

requirements.section: Documents, Templates, Media and Secure File Handling
requirements.short_requirement: Templates MUST use allowlisted merge fields and tenant branding; unknown/unsafe merge fields MUST fail clearly.

requirements.section: Documents, Templates, Media and Secure File Handling
requirements.short_requirement: Generated PDFs MUST be stored with metadata linking tenant, source entity, template/version, creator and generated timestamp.

requirements.section: Documents, Templates, Media and Secure File Handling
requirements.short_requirement: Media assets MUST require alt text/accessibility metadata for meaningful public images.

requirements.section: Documents, Templates, Media and Secure File Handling
requirements.short_requirement: Full-text search and OCR MAY be enabled as an extension; OCR output MUST not bypass document ACLs.

requirements.section: Communications, Templates, Segmentation and Delivery
requirements.short_requirement: Email templates MUST support global and tenant variants, validated merge fields, preview and test-send.

requirements.section: Communications, Templates, Segmentation and Delivery
requirements.short_requirement: Campaign segmentation MUST be applied server-side and support at least member status, dues/arrears state, candidate status and groups/tags where data is available.

requirements.section: Communications, Templates, Segmentation and Delivery
requirements.short_requirement: Before send/schedule, the UI MUST show a recipient preview/count derived from the exact segment query.

requirements.section: Communications, Templates, Segmentation and Delivery
requirements.short_requirement: Campaigns MUST have Draft/Scheduled/Sending/Sent/Failed/Cance lled lifecycle and MUST not allow clients to fake a sent status.

requirements.section: Communications, Templates, Segmentation and Delivery
requirements.short_requirement: Scheduled campaigns MUST be dispatched by the background job system and be idempotent under retry.

requirements.section: Communications, Templates, Segmentation and Delivery
requirements.short_requirement: Delivery logs MUST record recipient, provider/message reference, status, attempts and error metadata without exposing message secrets.

requirements.section: Communications, Templates, Segmentation and Delivery
requirements.short_requirement: Transient delivery failures SHOULD be retried with bounded backoff; permanent failures should be recorded and surfaced.

requirements.section: Communications, Templates, Segmentation and Delivery
requirements.short_requirement: Communication preferences/consent MUST be respected where legally or contractually required, while required administrative notices may follow tenant policy.

requirements.section: Communications, Templates, Segmentation and Delivery
requirements.short_requirement: SMS MAY be enabled through an approved provider and MUST use the same permission, audit and template principles.

requirements.section: Reports, Analytics, Exports and Scheduled Packs
requirements.short_requirement: The Reports workspace MUST provide membership, attendance, candidate pipeline, finance and compliance report families.

requirements.section: Reports, Analytics, Exports and Scheduled Packs
requirements.short_requirement: Every report MUST apply active tenant and permission scoping before aggregation.

requirements.section: Reports, Analytics, Exports and Scheduled Packs
requirements.short_requirement: Reports MUST support relevant date range, status and domain-specific filters and MUST disclose the applied filter set in the output metadata.

requirements.section: Reports, Analytics, Exports and Scheduled Packs
requirements.short_requirement: Where useful, reports MUST provide summary KPIs, trend visualization and detail tables; totals MUST reconcile to source records.

requirements.section: Reports, Analytics, Exports and Scheduled Packs
requirements.short_requirement: Exports MUST support PDF plus CSV/Excel where tabular data is meaningful.

requirements.section: Reports, Analytics, Exports and Scheduled Packs
requirements.short_requirement: Generated report files MUST be auditable with creator/schedule, tenant, report ID, filter parameters, generated timestamp, record count and file hash where practical.

requirements.section: Reports, Analytics, Exports and Scheduled Packs
requirements.short_requirement: Scheduled report definitions MUST be executed by Celery Beat/background jobs; merely storing a cron string is not sufficient.

requirements.section: Reports, Analytics, Exports and Scheduled Packs
requirements.short_requirement: Scheduled monthly packs MUST generate selected attachments, store them and deliver them to the configured authorized recipients, with delivery logs and retry behaviour.

requirements.section: Reports, Analytics, Exports and Scheduled Packs
requirements.short_requirement: Reports over a configurable sensitivity/record threshold MAY require approval before generation/download.

requirements.section: Reports, Analytics, Exports and Scheduled Packs
requirements.short_requirement: Large report generation MUST run asynchronously with progress/status rather than blocking interactive web workers.

requirements.section: Reports, Analytics, Exports and Scheduled Packs
requirements.short_requirement: Saved report views SHOULD retain filters, grouping, sorting and selected columns and remain private/shared according to permissions.

requirements.section: Reports, Analytics, Exports and Scheduled Packs
requirements.short_requirement: Analytics charts MUST not use color alone to convey meaning and must include labels/tooltips or accessible equivalents.

requirements.section: Professional Report and Generated-Document Standards
requirements.short_requirement: Formal PDF outputs MUST use tenant branding, lodge name/number and a consistent report/document template.

requirements.section: Professional Report and Generated-Document Standards
requirements.short_requirement: Default page size MUST be configurable between A4 and Letter; A4 is the default. Wide tabular reports SHOULD automatically use landscape orientation.

requirements.section: Professional Report and Generated-Document Standards
requirements.short_requirement: Multi-page reports MUST include repeating headers, page numbers, generated timestamp and report period/filter metadata.

requirements.section: Professional Report and Generated-Document Standards
requirements.short_requirement: Tables MUST avoid clipped text, orphaned headers and unreadably small type; long tables must repeat headings and paginate cleanly.

requirements.section: Professional Report and Generated-Document Standards
requirements.short_requirement: Charts MUST include title, units, labels/legend and accessible non-color cues where necessary.

requirements.section: Professional Report and Generated-Document Standards
requirements.short_requirement: Executive/pack reports MUST include a cover/header section and executive summary before detailed sections.

requirements.section: Professional Report and Generated-Document Standards
requirements.short_requirement: Confidential reports SHOULD carry a configurable confidentiality classification in the header/footer.

requirements.section: Professional Report and Generated-Document Standards
requirements.short_requirement: Generated text and tables MUST remain selectable/searchable in the PDF; reports SHOULD not be delivered as rasterized screenshots.

requirements.section: Professional Report and Generated-Document Standards
requirements.short_requirement: Financial outputs MUST format currency consistently and include totals/subtotals with clear sign conventions.

requirements.section: Professional Report and Generated-Document Standards
requirements.short_requirement: Generated file names MUST be safe, deterministic and meaningful, including tenant/report/date identifiers without leaking unnecessary PII.

requirements.section: Audit, Compliance, Sensitive Exports and Impersonation
requirements.short_requirement: All mutations of protected business records MUST create an audit event containing tenant, actor, action, object identity, timestamp and safe change metadata.

requirements.section: Audit, Compliance, Sensitive Exports and Impersonation
requirements.short_requirement: Exports, impersonation, role/permission changes, credential changes and security- policy changes MUST be audited.

requirements.section: Audit, Compliance, Sensitive Exports and Impersonation
requirements.short_requirement: Audit records MUST be append-only to normal application roles; corrections must be additive rather than editing prior events.

requirements.section: Audit, Compliance, Sensitive Exports and Impersonation
requirements.short_requirement: The system SHOULD implement hash chaining or equivalent tamper-evidence for high-value audit events.

requirements.section: Audit, Compliance, Sensitive Exports and Impersonation
requirements.short_requirement: Audit viewers MUST support date, actor, module/action and object filters while remaining tenant/role scoped.

requirements.section: Audit, Compliance, Sensitive Exports and Impersonation
requirements.short_requirement: Sensitive export requests SHOULD support approval with requester, reason, approver, decision and expiry.

requirements.section: Audit, Compliance, Sensitive Exports and Impersonation
requirements.short_requirement: Export logs MUST record report/export type, filters, record count, format, requester, approver (if any), timestamp and result.

requirements.section: Audit, Compliance, Sensitive Exports and Impersonation
requirements.short_requirement: Secret values, passwords and full payment credentials MUST never be written into audit or application logs.

requirements.section: Subscription Billing and Payment Provider Integrations
requirements.short_requirement: Stripe MUST support subscription checkout, monthly/annual plans as configured, customer portal and relevant webhook- driven subscription state updates.

requirements.section: Subscription Billing and Payment Provider Integrations
requirements.short_requirement: PayMongo and Xendit MUST support configured one-off payment requests/links for tenant financial operations where enabled.

requirements.section: Subscription Billing and Payment Provider Integrations
requirements.short_requirement: Provider credentials and webhook secrets MUST be encrypted at rest, separated by test/live mode and never returned to the frontend after storage.

requirements.section: Subscription Billing and Payment Provider Integrations
requirements.short_requirement: A local payment-request record MUST be persisted before accepting asynchronous provider settlement, including tenant, amount, currency, internal reference, provider reference and mode.

requirements.section: Subscription Billing and Payment Provider Integrations
requirements.short_requirement: Webhook tenant resolution MUST use signed tenant/environment-scoped URLs and/or verified provider metadata; the system MUST NOT depend on providers sending custom application headers they do not control.

requirements.section: Subscription Billing and Payment Provider Integrations
requirements.short_requirement: Webhook signatures/tokens MUST be verified before business reconciliation.

requirements.section: Subscription Billing and Payment Provider Integrations
requirements.short_requirement: Webhook processing MUST be idempotent and race-safe; duplicate/replayed events MUST never double-credit a payment or issue duplicate receipts.

requirements.section: Subscription Billing and Payment Provider Integrations
requirements.short_requirement: Amount, currency, mode and provider reference MUST be reconciled; mismatches/unrecognized payments MUST be quarantined for review rather than silently applied.

requirements.section: Subscription Billing and Payment Provider Integrations
requirements.short_requirement: Webhook HTTP handlers SHOULD verify -> persist event -> acknowledge quickly -> perform heavier reconciliation in background.

requirements.section: Subscription Billing and Payment Provider Integrations
requirements.short_requirement: Checkout/portal return URLs MUST be validated against approved origins and HTTPS requirements in production.

requirements.section: Subscription Billing and Payment Provider Integrations
requirements.short_requirement: Provider retry/replay tooling MUST preserve idempotency and full audit/log history.

requirements.section: Offline/PWA Continuity, Synchronisation and Conflict Handling
requirements.short_requirement: The web application SHOULD provide installable PWA shell caching for repeat navigation on supported browsers.

requirements.section: Offline/PWA Continuity, Synchronisation and Conflict Handling
requirements.short_requirement: Private API data MUST NOT be stored unencrypted in browser CacheStorage.

requirements.section: Offline/PWA Continuity, Synchronisation and Conflict Handling
requirements.short_requirement: If offline private snapshots are supported, they MUST be encrypted at rest in browser storage and bound to the authenticated user/tenant context.

requirements.section: Offline/PWA Continuity, Synchronisation and Conflict Handling
requirements.short_requirement: Only an explicit allowlist of low-risk CRUD operations MAY queue offline; payments, waivers, credentials, MFA, impersonation, approvals, bulk privacy actions and file uploads MUST remain online-only.

requirements.section: Offline/PWA Continuity, Synchronisation and Conflict Handling
requirements.short_requirement: Queued writes MUST use idempotency keys so replay cannot create duplicates.

requirements.section: Offline/PWA Continuity, Synchronisation and Conflict Handling
requirements.short_requirement: Offline edits MUST carry a source version/updated_at value; stale replay MUST return a conflict (for example 409) instead of silently overwriting newer server data.

requirements.section: Offline/PWA Continuity, Synchronisation and Conflict Handling
requirements.short_requirement: The UI MUST surface synchronization state, failures and conflicts and MUST not silently drop unsynchronized changes.

requirements.section: Offline/PWA Continuity, Synchronisation and Conflict Handling
requirements.short_requirement: Logout MUST warn before discarding unsynchronized work and clear/decryptable user-bound private offline data according to policy.

requirements.section: Data Import, Bulk Operations, Search and Saved Views
requirements.short_requirement: Imports MUST validate file type, file size, headers, row count and field values before commit.

requirements.section: Data Import, Bulk Operations, Search and Saved Views
requirements.short_requirement: CSV/XLSX imports MUST show mapping and preview plus row-level errors; invalid rows MUST not be silently accepted.

requirements.section: Data Import, Bulk Operations, Search and Saved Views
requirements.short_requirement: Imports SHOULD support dry-run/transactional commit so failed batches do not leave partially unpredictable state.

requirements.section: Data Import, Bulk Operations, Search and Saved Views
requirements.short_requirement: Bulk operations MUST display impacted record count and require explicit confirmation for destructive/high-impact actions.

requirements.section: Data Import, Bulk Operations, Search and Saved Views
requirements.short_requirement: Advanced data tables MUST support server-compatible filtering, sorting, pagination and saved views for major modules.

requirements.section: Data Import, Bulk Operations, Search and Saved Views
requirements.short_requirement: Inline editing MAY be offered for low-risk fields but MUST apply the same server validation/RBAC/audit controls as full forms.

requirements.section: Data Import, Bulk Operations, Search and Saved Views
requirements.short_requirement: No list/search endpoint may return ounded tenant datasets by default.

requirements.section: Background Jobs, Notifications and Scheduling
requirements.short_requirement: Long-running PDF/report, campaign, import and reconciliation work MUST execute outside synchronous web requests.

requirements.section: Background Jobs, Notifications and Scheduling
requirements.short_requirement: Scheduled tasks MUST use a single authoritative scheduler/locking strategy to prevent duplicate execution.

requirements.section: Background Jobs, Notifications and Scheduling
requirements.short_requirement: Jobs MUST be idempotent or carry idempotency/deduplication guards where retries can occur.

requirements.section: Background Jobs, Notifications and Scheduling
requirements.short_requirement: Retryable jobs SHOULD use bounded exponential backoff and terminal failure state after configured attempts.

requirements.section: Background Jobs, Notifications and Scheduling
requirements.short_requirement: Operators MUST be able to see job status/failures and safely retry eligible failed jobs.

requirements.section: Background Jobs, Notifications and Scheduling
requirements.short_requirement: Background jobs MUST re-validate tenant context and permissions/business invariants; they may not trust stale browser data.

requirements.section: API, Webhooks and Integration Contracts
requirements.short_requirement: The production backend MUST expose documented API contracts for all UI- required operations; API documentation MUST be delivered.

requirements.section: API, Webhooks and Integration Contracts
requirements.short_requirement: API errors MUST use consistent status codes and safe machine-readable error bodies without stack traces/secrets in production.

requirements.section: API, Webhooks and Integration Contracts
requirements.short_requirement: List APIs MUST support bounded pagination and documented filtering/sorting semantics.

requirements.section: API, Webhooks and Integration Contracts
requirements.short_requirement: Mutation endpoints that may be retried SHOULD support idempotency keys where duplicate business records would be harmful.

requirements.section: API, Webhooks and Integration Contracts
requirements.short_requirement: Browser mutations MUST be protected against CSRF according to the selected authentication model.

requirements.section: API, Webhooks and Integration Contracts
requirements.short_requirement: CORS MUST use an explicit production allowlist; wildcard credentialed origins are prohibited.

requirements.section: API, Webhooks and Integration Contracts
requirements.short_requirement: External webhook endpoints MUST be provider-authenticated, rate-protected and idempotent.

requirements.section: API, Webhooks and Integration Contracts
requirements.short_requirement: Health/readiness endpoints MUST distinguish application readiness from mere process liveness.

requirements.section: API, Webhooks and Integration Contracts
requirements.short_requirement: A versioning/deprecation strategy MUST be documented before any public third-party API is declared stable.

requirements.section: Security Engineering and Application Hardening
requirements.short_requirement: Security design and QA MUST address common OWASP web risks including broken access control, injection, XSS, CSRF, insecure design, authentication failures and SSRF/open redirects where applicable.

requirements.section: Security Engineering and Application Hardening
requirements.short_requirement: Secrets MUST be supplied through environment/secret management and MUST never be committed to the repository.

requirements.section: Security Engineering and Application Hardening
requirements.short_requirement: Provider credentials and sensitive configuration values MUST use authenticated encryption at rest with key material separated from ciphertext storage.

requirements.section: Security Engineering and Application Hardening
requirements.short_requirement: Production MUST enforce HTTPS and appropriate security headers including HSTS where deployment permits, clickjacking protection, MIME-sniff prevention and a deliberate CSP strategy.

requirements.section: Security Engineering and Application Hardening
requirements.short_requirement: Rate limiting MUST protect authentication, public forms, sensitive endpoints and abuse-prone APIs using shared state suitable for multi-process deployment.

requirements.section: Security Engineering and Application Hardening
requirements.short_requirement: File upload validation/malware scanning MUST follow Section 14 and must not trust browser-provided MIME alone.

requirements.section: Security Engineering and Application Hardening
requirements.short_requirement: Application/database/worker service accounts MUST follow least privilege; production containers SHOULD run non- root.

requirements.section: Security Engineering and Application Hardening
requirements.short_requirement: Dependency and container vulnerability scanning MUST be part of CI/release evidence, with critical/high findings triaged before release.

requirements.section: Security Engineering and Application Hardening
requirements.short_requirement: Sensitive logs MUST be redacted; no passwords, tokens, full card/payment credentials or encryption keys may appear in logs.

requirements.section: Security Engineering and Application Hardening
requirements.short_requirement: Security-relevant administrative changes MUST generate audit events and SHOULD trigger alerts for selected high-risk events.

requirements.section: Privacy, Retention, Data Integrity and Lifecycle Controls
requirements.short_requirement: Tenant data MUST be logically isolated in storage, cache, background jobs, exports and browser offline stores.

requirements.section: Privacy, Retention, Data Integrity and Lifecycle Controls
requirements.short_requirement: Retention policies MUST be configurable by data category where operationally appropriate and must not silently erase protected financial/audit records.

requirements.section: Privacy, Retention, Data Integrity and Lifecycle Controls
requirements.short_requirement: Member anonymization/deletion MUST remove or de-identify unnecessary PII while preserving required relational, financial and audit integrity.

requirements.section: Privacy, Retention, Data Integrity and Lifecycle Controls
requirements.short_requirement: Exports of personal/sensitive data MUST be permission-controlled and audited.

requirements.section: Privacy, Retention, Data Integrity and Lifecycle Controls
requirements.short_requirement: Timestamps MUST be stored consistently (preferably UTC) and rendered using tenant/user timezone settings.

requirements.section: Privacy, Retention, Data Integrity and Lifecycle Controls
requirements.short_requirement: Currency/decimal calculations MUST use decimal-safe numeric types rather than binary floating-point for financial totals.

requirements.section: Privacy, Retention, Data Integrity and Lifecycle Controls
requirements.short_requirement: Tenant foreign-key relationships MUST be validated so objects from another tenant cannot be attached through manipulated IDs.

requirements.section: UI/UX, Accessibility, Responsive Behaviour and Design System
requirements.short_requirement: The application MUST be responsive across phone, tablet and desktop breakpoints without horizontal clipping of primary workflows.

requirements.section: UI/UX, Accessibility, Responsive Behaviour and Design System
requirements.short_requirement: The UI MUST use a shared design system for typography, spacing, forms, buttons, tables, dialogs, alerts and status badges.

requirements.section: UI/UX, Accessibility, Responsive Behaviour and Design System
requirements.short_requirement: Interactive controls MUST provide hover/focus/disabled/loading states and clear validation/errors.

requirements.section: UI/UX, Accessibility, Responsive Behaviour and Design System
requirements.short_requirement: Keyboard navigation, visible focus, semantic headings/form labels and sufficient color contrast MUST meet WCAG 2.2 AA intent for primary workflows.

requirements.section: UI/UX, Accessibility, Responsive Behaviour and Design System
requirements.short_requirement: Animations/micro-interactions SHOULD use Framer Motion or equivalent and MUST respect prefers-reduced-motion.

requirements.section: UI/UX, Accessibility, Responsive Behaviour and Design System
requirements.short_requirement: Destructive actions MUST use branded confirmation UI with meaningful consequences and in-progress/error handling.

requirements.section: UI/UX, Accessibility, Responsive Behaviour and Design System
requirements.short_requirement: Advanced tables MUST support filtering, sorting, pagination and saved views; dense data should remain usable on smaller screens.

requirements.section: UI/UX, Accessibility, Responsive Behaviour and Design System
requirements.short_requirement: Empty states MUST explain what the module does and, when authorized, provide the next useful action.

requirements.section: UI/UX, Accessibility, Responsive Behaviour and Design System
requirements.short_requirement: Toast/notification messages MUST be actionable, concise and must not be the only place critical error detail is available.

requirements.section: UI/UX, Accessibility, Responsive Behaviour and Design System
requirements.short_requirement: At least five curated accessible theme presets SHOULD be available or equivalent branding flexibility must be provided.

requirements.section: Performance, Scalability and Availability Targets
requirements.short_requirement: On the reference production profile (approximately 8 vCPU, 12 GB RAM, NVMe), standard cached/list CRUD API requests SHOULD achieve p95 server response below 700 ms under representative load excluding third-party provider latency.

requirements.section: Performance, Scalability and Availability Targets
requirements.short_requirement: Primary page navigation SHOULD target Largest Contentful Paint below 2.5 s on typical broadband for warmed/static assets.

requirements.section: Performance, Scalability and Availability Targets
requirements.short_requirement: Operations expected to exceed 5 seconds (large reports, exports, imports, bulk sends) MUST be asynchronous.

requirements.section: Performance, Scalability and Availability Targets
requirements.short_requirement: Major list endpoints MUST use pagination and appropriate database indexes; N+1 query patterns in high-traffic views MUST be addressed.

requirements.section: Performance, Scalability and Availability Targets
requirements.short_requirement: The release load test SHOULD cover at least 100 tenants, 50,000 members, 250,000 attendance rows, 100,000 assessments/payments, 20,000 documents metadata rows and 100 concurrent sessions using generated data.

requirements.section: Performance, Scalability and Availability Targets
requirements.short_requirement: The system MUST degrade safely when Redis, object storage, email or a payment provider is temporarily unavailable and must surface retryable failures rather than corrupting state.

requirements.section: Performance, Scalability and Availability Targets
requirements.short_requirement: A monthly availability target of 99.5% excluding agreed maintenance SHOULD be used for the baseline single-region service unless a different SLA is contracted.

requirements.section: Observability, Logging, Health and Operations
requirements.short_requirement: Production MUST emit structured logs with timestamp, severity, service and correlation/request ID where applicable.

requirements.section: Observability, Logging, Health and Operations
requirements.short_requirement: Unhandled application errors SHOULD be reported to Sentry or an equivalent error- tracking system with PII minimization.

requirements.section: Observability, Logging, Health and Operations
requirements.short_requirement: Liveness and readiness checks MUST cover web/backend and essential dependencies required to serve traffic.

requirements.section: Observability, Logging, Health and Operations
requirements.short_requirement: Operators MUST be able to inspect failed background jobs, webhook events and email delivery outcomes.

requirements.section: Observability, Logging, Health and Operations
requirements.short_requirement: Alerts SHOULD cover service-down, repeated job failures, database/storage capacity, certificate expiry and abnormal authentication/security events.

requirements.section: Observability, Logging, Health and Operations
requirements.short_requirement: Logs and traces MUST not expose secrets or unnecessary PII.

requirements.section: Backup, Restore and Disaster Recovery
requirements.short_requirement: Production PostgreSQL MUST be backed up automatically at least daily, with backups stored separately from the primary VPS/database.

requirements.section: Backup, Restore and Disaster Recovery
requirements.short_requirement: Backup archives MUST be encrypted in transit and at rest and protected by access controls separate from normal application users.

requirements.section: Backup, Restore and Disaster Recovery
requirements.short_requirement: Critical private documents/generated files MUST be protected by object-storage versioning/backup or equivalent recovery mechanism.

requirements.section: Backup, Restore and Disaster Recovery
requirements.short_requirement: Restore tooling MUST verify checksums/integrity and require explicit confirmation before destructive restore ons.

requirements.section: Backup, Restore and Disaster Recovery
requirements.short_requirement: A full non-production restore drill MUST prove database and representative files can be restored and reconciled.

requirements.section: Backup, Restore and Disaster Recovery
requirements.short_requirement: Baseline recovery targets SHOULD be RPO <= 24 hours and RTO <= 4 hours after infrastructure/access is available, unless a stricter SLA is contracted.

requirements.section: Backup, Restore and Disaster Recovery
requirements.short_requirement: Backups MUST not be considered complete until monitoring can detect failed backup jobs.

requirements.section: Backup, Restore and Disaster Recovery
requirements.short_requirement: A documented disaster-recovery runbook MUST be delivered and reviewed before production sign-off.

requirements.section: DevOps, Environments, Deployment and Release Management
requirements.short_requirement: Local development MUST be reproducible through Docker Compose or an equivalent documented stack including PostgreSQL, Redis, backend, frontend and worker services.

requirements.section: DevOps, Environments, Deployment and Release Management
requirements.short_requirement: Production MUST use a distinct production Compose/deployment configuration and production-safe settings.

requirements.section: DevOps, Environments, Deployment and Release Management
requirements.short_requirement: CI MUST run backend checks/tests, migration drift check, frontend syntax/typecheck/build and security/dependency checks appropriate to the release.

requirements.section: DevOps, Environments, Deployment and Release Management
requirements.short_requirement: Staging MUST use production-like PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, storage, email sandbox/test and payment-provider sandbox integrations before release.

requirements.section: DevOps, Environments, Deployment and Release Management
requirements.short_requirement: Database migrations MUST be committed, reviewed and tested on both a fresh database and an upgrade path from the prior release.

requirements.section: DevOps, Environments, Deployment and Release Management
requirements.short_requirement: Deployment MUST not publish a release healthy until migrations and essential health checks succeed.

requirements.section: DevOps, Environments, Deployment and Release Management
requirements.short_requirement: Rollback procedures MUST distinguish application rollback from non-reversible database migration; migration rollback risk must be documented per release.

requirements.section: DevOps, Environments, Deployment and Release Management
requirements.short_requirement: Secrets MUST be injected at deployment and not embedded in images or repository files.

requirements.section: DevOps, Environments, Deployment and Release Management
requirements.short_requirement: Only intended public ports (typically 80/443 and restricted SSH) SHOULD be externally reachable; PostgreSQL/Redis MUST remain private.

requirements.section: DevOps, Environments, Deployment and Release Management
requirements.short_requirement: TLS certificates and domain configuration MUST be monitored for expiry/misconfiguration.

requirements.section: QA Automation, Test Strategy and Requirements Traceability
requirements.short_requirement: A machine-readable requirements traceability matrix MUST map every MUST requirement ID to one or more automated/manual test IDs and latest result.

requirements.section: QA Automation, Test Strategy and Requirements Traceability
requirements.short_requirement: Backend tests MUST run against PostgreSQL for integration-critical behaviour including tenant isolation, RBAC, finance, audit and workflow state machines.

requirements.section: QA Automation, Test Strategy and Requirements Traceability
requirements.short_requirement: Browser E2E MUST use Playwright or equivalent to test core user journeys against the running stack.

requirements.section: QA Automation, Test Strategy and Requirements Traceability
requirements.short_requirement: Security QA MUST include cross-tenant IDOR, privilege escalation, CSRF/CORS, open redirect, upload abuse, rate limiting, secrets and dependency/container scanning.

requirements.section: QA Automation, Test Strategy and Requirements Traceability
requirements.short_requirement: Financial QA MUST include duplicate webhooks, concurrency, amount mismatch, idempotency and receipt-number race tests.

requirements.section: QA Automation, Test Strategy and Requirements Traceability
requirements.short_requirement: Report QA MUST reconcile totals to source data and validate generated PDF structure/layout under empty, normal and extreme datasets.

requirements.section: QA Automation, Test Strategy and Requirements Traceability
requirements.short_requirement: Accessibility QA MUST include automated axe-style checks plus manual keyboard/focus/reduced-motion review of primary workflows.

requirements.section: QA Automation, Test Strategy and Requirements Traceability
requirements.short_requirement: Backup QA MUST perform an actual restore and verify representative data/file integrity.

requirements.section: QA Automation, Test Strategy and Requirements Traceability
requirements.short_requirement: Every confirmed defect SHOULD first receive a regression test that fails before the fix and passes after the fix where practical.

requirements.section: QA Automation, Test Strategy and Requirements Traceability
requirements.short_requirement: Source-string/static release assertions MAY supplement but MUST NOT replace runtime integration/E2E testing.

requirements.section: QA Automation, Test Strategy and Requirements Traceability
requirements.short_requirement: Test failures MUST produce actionable logs and screenshots/traces for browser failures.

requirements.section: Staging, UAT and Production Acceptance
requirements.short_requirement: A release MUST NOT enter production until local/CI release gates are green and a production-like staging deployment succeeds.

requirements.section: Staging, UAT and Production Acceptance
requirements.short_requirement: Staging MUST validate SMTP/email, S3- compatible storage, Redis/Celery/Beat, ClamAV, Stripe sandbox and enabled PayMongo/Xendit test callbacks.

requirements.section: Staging, UAT and Production Acceptance
requirements.short_requirement: UAT MUST exercise at least one full workflow for authentication/MFA, member lifecycle, candidate progression, meeting/minutes, dues/payment/receipt, documents, communications, reports and platform admin.

requirements.section: Staging, UAT and Production Acceptance
requirements.short_requirement: Production release MUST have zero open P0/Critical and P1/High defects; any accepted lower-severity defect requires documented owner/target release.

requirements.section: Staging, UAT and Production Acceptance
requirements.short_requirement: A production smoke test MUST run immediately after deployment and verify login, tenant load, key API health, background queue, one safe CRUD workflow and public website.

requirements.section: Staging, UAT and Production Acceptance
requirements.short_requirement: Rollback/restore instructions and latest verified backup MUST be available before production change begins.

requirements.section: Staging, UAT and Production Acceptance
requirements.short_requirement: Final report/document visual samples MUST be approved during UAT because generated documents are a contractual product output, not an implementation detail.

requirements.section: Final Delivery Package and Release Sign-Off
requirements.short_requirement: Delivery MUST include complete source code for frontend/backend/workers and all committed database migrations.

requirements.section: Final Delivery Package and Release Sign-Off
requirements.short_requirement: Delivery MUST include Dockerfiles/Compose, environment examples, CI workflows and deployment scripts/instructions.

requirements.section: Final Delivery Package and Release Sign-Off
requirements.short_requirement: Delivery MUST include API/OpenAPI documentation, database/data-model documentation and administrator/operator documentation.

requirements.section: Final Delivery Package and Release Sign-Off
requirements.short_requirement: Delivery MUST include automated QA suites and the final traceability/QA report.

requirements.section: Final Delivery Package and Release Sign-Off
requirements.short_requirement: Delivery MUST include backup/restore and disaster-recovery runbooks plus latest verified restore evidence.

requirements.section: Final Delivery Package and Release Sign-Off
requirements.short_requirement: Delivery MUST include security/dependency scan summaries, SBOM/dependency licence inventory and known-risk register.

requirements.section: Final Delivery Package and Release Sign-Off
requirements.short_requirement: Delivery MUST include representative approved PDFs: receipt, member statement, officer roster, minutes, summons, attendance sheet, meeting pack and onthly management report pack.

requirements.section: Final Delivery Package and Release Sign-Off
requirements.short_requirement: Delivery MUST include release notes/changelog and documented configuration needed for SMTP/storage/payment providers without embedding live secrets.

requirements.section: Final Delivery Package and Release Sign-Off
requirements.short_requirement: Final acceptance MUST be recorded against the sign-off checklist in this specification or an equivalent signed delivery record.
